group.name: State Government (Madhya Pradesh aur dusre States)
group.intro: MP mein officer posts MPPSC bharta hai aur Group C aur D posts MP Employees Selection Board (MPESB), pehle Vyapam, bharta hai. Reservation aur age relaxation sirf MP domicile walon ko milta hai. Fees, age limit, pay aur physical standards recruitment, post, category aur domicile ke hisaab se alag hote hain; har recruitment ki MPESB ya MPPSC rulebook mein confirm karein.
group.ageRelaxation.rows.0.rule: Rulebook ke hisaab se tay (non-uniform posts ke liye aam taur par reserved upper limit 45)
group.ageRelaxation.rows.6.rule: Zyaadatar posts par mahilaon ko reserved category ki upper limit milti hai
group.ageRelaxation.rows.7.rule: State police rules ke hisaab se
group.ageRelaxation.rows.8.rule: Sirf open seats, koi relaxation nahi
group.ageRelaxation.notes.0: Final-year students aam taur par graduate exams mein apply kar sakte hain, agar notice ki cut-off date tak unke paas degree hogi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.1: Chhoot sirf MP ke domicile candidates ko milti hai; dusre state ke candidates sirf open seats par apply kar sakte hain, bina chhoot ke. Har MPESB / MPPSC rulebook final hai.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.2: MP ki dusri chhoot (rulebook ke hisaab se): MP government employees, Nagar Sainik, Home Guard volunteers aur ex-servicemen ko extra saal milte hain; working Anganwadi workers ko Supervisor post ke liye chhoot milti hai.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.3: Age har rulebook mein di gayi date par gini jaati hai (Police Constable test ke liye 6 October 2026).
